branch_offset_semantics: 16-bit sign-extended byte offset; target = instruction_address + offset.  The field position is per-opcode: jmp_exec_none (0xc020) uses the THIRD word (bits 32..47); call (0xc010) and jmp_exec_any (0xc000) use the SECOND word (bits 16..31).  A real offset field is ~100% congruent to 0 mod 6, because every instruction is 6 bytes; jmp_exec_none's is 15243/15244, call's is 4/4, and jmp_exec_any's is 33/40 versus 4/65 for the non-multiples (so most 0xc000 words that land on an instruction start are coincidental payload).

branch_target_hit_rate_by_opcode.jmp_exec_any (0xc000, offset in word 1): 37/105 (but 33/40 for the offsets that are multiples of 6, versus 4/65 for the rest -- most 0xc000 words that land on an instruction start are coincidental payload, not real branches)

model: uniform 6-byte (3 x 16-bit word) instruction; trap/stop 2 bytes; A11-only opcodes 6 bytes unless listed below
